title: Small Group: Willamette Valley Wine Tour From Portland (Tasting Fees Included)
includes: Round Trip Transportation from Downtown Portland
Wine Tasting Fees Included @ 3 Wineries (Typically $130-150 per person)
Lunch, can be purchased individualy (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
The Northern Willamette Valley's close proximity to Portland creates a perfect opportunity to join others on a small group public tour of Oregon’s wine country with Sea to Summit Tours, Portland Oregon's original tour and adventure company. 

Experienced, knowledgeable guides, providing fun and informative tours with unparalleled customer service, while operating the nicest and most comfortable, custom equipped 4x4 Mercedes-Benz vehicles in Portland’s tour industry.

We set an itinerary with outstanding wine, great hospitality, and beautiful scenery with wine tasting fees included – all the keys to creating a unforgettable Willamette Valley Wine Tour for our clients... Created, owned and operated by native Portland Oregonian's, since 2001
